def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    vals={v for row in grid for v in row}
    marker=next(v for v in vals if v not in (0,1))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    def norm(ps):
        a=min(r for r,c in ps); b=min(c for r,c in ps)
        return frozenset((r-a,c-b) for r,c in ps)
    shape=norm(pts)
    variants=set()
    for refl in (False,True):
      for rot in range(4):
        q=[]
        for r,c in shape:
          if refl: c=-c
          for _ in range(rot): r,c=c,-r
          q.append((r,c))
        variants.add(norm(q))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for sh in variants:
      mh=max(r for r,c in sh); mw=max(c for r,c in sh)
      for r0 in range(h-mh):
        for c0 in range(w-mw):
          cells=[(r0+r,c0+c) for r,c in sh]
          if all(grid[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells):
            for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=marker
    return out
